# ARRI

> > ARRI provides professional cinema cameras, LED lighting systems, and intelligent control tools for film and broadcast production.

ARRI is a leading manufacturer of camera systems (ALEXA series, AMIRA), LED lighting fixtures (SkyPanel, L-Series, Orbiter), and the Stellar intelligent lighting control app. The company offers comprehensive tools for cinematographers, gaffers, and production teams including data rate calculators and workflow solutions.

## Key Topics

- ALEXA 35 and ALEXA 35 Xtreme cameras
- AMIRA camera system
- Stellar lighting control app
- SkyPanel LED fixtures
- L-Series and Orbiter lighting
- DMX, ArtNet, sACN, and RDM protocols
- Professional cinema lighting workflow
- Camera formats and recording codecs
- Color control and LED fixture management
- Film and broadcast production tools
- iOS and Android mobile apps
- Production planning and data rate calculation
- Storage requirements for cinema cameras

## Lighting Control & Mobile Apps

- [Stellar. The intelligent lighting control app from ARRI.](https://microsites.arri.com/): Stellar 2 lighting control app for iOS/Android with DMX and third-party support

## Production Tools & Calculators

- [ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator](https://tools.arri.com/fileadmin/adapps/afdc/index.html): Storage calculator for ALEXA camera formats and production data rates
